topic: From 'I don't know what I'm good at' to first paying client
caption:
Most teens don't lack talent. They lack a starting point.
HustleUp walks your teen through finding one real skill, building a simple offer, and landing their first paying client.
Parents tell us the change they notice isn't just the money. It's how their kid carries themselves.
Give them a head start → hustleup.us
